lines.en: Grandma, which season do you like best?
I like spring. The air is fresh and mild.
I like summer. I swim in the sea.
Last summer we went to the beach together.
Yes! The sun was bright all day.
What about autumn? The leaves are beautiful.
Autumn is nice, but winter is dark and cold.
In winter, we can drink warm tea at home.
lines.ko: 겨울엔 집에서 따뜻한 차를 마실 수 있어요.

lines.en: Will you walk with me next spring?
lines.ko: 내년 봄에 저랑 같이 걸어 줄래요?

lines.en: Sure. We will see the flowers together.
Can you help me with the winter clothes?
Sure, Mom. Where do you want them?
Put the thick coats in that box, please.
lines.ko: 두꺼운 코트는 저 상자에 넣어 주세요.

lines.en: The season changes fast. It's already warm.
Yes. Spring is mild, and the days are bright.
This jacket got wet in the rain last week.
Please wash it before summer comes.
Okay. Will you need this warm hat?
No. I will wear it again in autumn.
Good. Now your room looks fresh and clean.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 이제 방이 산뜻하고 깨끗해 보여요.
